survey: A DJ controller seen from the front at three-quarter view, with headphones leaning against its front right corner. The controller is a rounded blue box. It stands on short stubby feet, visible at the front left and back right. Two purple jog wheels sit in round recesses, one on each side of the top. Between them is a raised center panel with two vertical channel faders, each a green cap riding in its own slot. Behind that panel, a small raised block holds three yellow-topped knobs. Along the front edge runs a row of square performance pads: yellow, green and pink on the left, pink, a wide pink and pink in the middle, and yellow, green and pink on the right. All the pads sit flush in the surface and could be pressed. The headphones are a full over-ear pair. One arched headband joins two ear cups through yoke connectors at each end. The near cup faces the camera and the far cup is behind it. Both cups rest on the floor and the headband leans against the controller's front edge, so the headphones are supported and do not float. The headphones have no cable, which reads as wireless and is acceptable.
